scope.statement: Independently audit PR #125 at 804f1658e27b424da16535b53bcb825c394c7711: derive V=R+B/2+k-h from face incidence and planar Euler, test annular and disconnected controls, and reconstruct the strict n-1 shell upper comparison.
scope.domain: Finite planar edge-to-edge complexes of unit rhombi with disjoint interiors, one or two incident faces per edge, and no dangling 1-cells. The source-count identity additionally assumes every complex vertex is a source label and t counts the remaining source labels; the canonical unit-separated source excludes nonvertex points from a unit rhombus.
scope.limitations: Audits bookkeeping and the strict upper side only. Does not prove the Target B shell lower bound, a source-preserving competitor, or any canonical theorem promotion.

result: The incidence identity and signs are correct: each extra component contributes +1 and each bounded hole -1. The strict shell upper side follows from the canonical n-1 lattice comparison and area decomposition under n=V+t. Independent exact annulus and disconnected controls pass.
remaining_questions: Prove G+E >= (sqrt(3)/4)B + (sqrt(3)/2)(t+k-h-1) across all canonical multi-grain/interface/topology cases, or construct a source-preserving strict sub-D competitor.
